features: ▪ 2-IN-1 TRANSMITTER & RECEIVER IN ONE DEVICE — Switch instantly between TX and RX modes with the multifunction button. In Transmitter mode, send audio from non-Bluetooth sources like your TV, PC, laptop, projector or in-flight airplane screen to wireless headphones and speakers. In Receiver mode, stream from your smartphone to a car stereo, wired speaker, amplifier or home theatre system — one ETZIN adapter handles both.

▪ LATEST BLUETOOTH 5.4 TECHNOLOGY — Powered by the newest Bluetooth 5.4 chipset for faster pairing, a more stable connection, extended wireless range and lower power consumption than older Bluetooth versions. Enjoy reliable, drop-free wireless audio whether you're at home, in the car or travelling.

▪ CONNECT TWO DEVICES SIMULTANEOUSLY — Pair two Bluetooth headphones at the same time and share your audio — perfect for watching movies, listening to music or sharing a podcast with a partner on a flight or road trip without disturbing anyone around you.

▪ UNIVERSAL 3.5MM COMPATIBILITY & EASY CONTROLS — The universal 3.5mm AUX jack with durable braided cable works with Smart TVs, laptops, desktop PCs, smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, amplifiers, car stereos, powered wired speakers, wired headphones, projectors and multi-speaker home theatre setups. Tactile +/– volume buttons and the multifunction (M) button give you precise control over volume, mode selection and EQ.

▪ ALL-DAY BATTERY & TRAVEL-READY DESIGN — Get up to 14 hours of playtime in Receiver mode and up to 11 hours in Transmitter mode on a single USB recharge. Lightweight, pocket-sized and easy to carry, the ETZIN adapter slips into a pocket, bag or travel organiser — making it the ideal companion for flights, commutes and daily use.
